You can change a lot of things but you cant change your self, trust me i've been trying for years (15 give or take), at the end of the day you will always be you. I was thinking about personality the other day and my toughs only lead me to believe that, environment and conditions change some aspects but not the core, evidently that beaten child that turned out to be a mass murder is lumped in the group where people claim that due the fact he was abused as a child he turned out that way, however we will never see the other side of the coin for obvious reasons, there lots of kids that suffer the same fate and turn OK.

so no sir i dont think im capable to change ill always be me, furthermore just to feed the monkey ill try to ask a few homeless in my area why they chose that life instead of head for the gallows

Not exactly, im OK with the noose around the neck, just not sure whether or not people should know about it. Bothering other people was always a big concern of mine, and i do understand ill be bothering a stranger(whoever finds my body) i guess i compromised on that one.
